function.representation: all five payload words tagged; positive fixnum code ID and version

registry.authority: owner-supplied fixture registry, no loader-authentication claim

captured_cell.identity: nx-root-var of each inherited variable; one cell per captured binding per activation

tail_entry.dispatch: paired per-Worker tail table, same slot indices as B table; owner supplied, not authenticated
tail_entry.temporary_callable: Immediately after padded arguments, aligned to 16 bytes; SELF and its environment pointer rebased before transfer. Payload cells remain shared heap objects.
tail_entry.retirement: One public wrapper restores original caller state on normal and exceptional completion. Temporary argument/root frames are retired before return_call_indirect. No calls or polls during relocation.

unwind_protect.checkpoint: Wasm locals; explicit stack cursor, root head, VSP, MV base, owner, count
unwind_protect.exception: Wasm exnref local; unchanged tag and payload on successful exceptional cleanup
unwind_protect.handler_chain: TCR handler_checkpoint at 140; unwind_state at 148; no safepoints/GC
unwind_protect.tail_legality: protected and cleanup IR not tail positions

control_record.exception: distinct shared nonlocal_exit tag carrying raw target-record address; Lisp values stay in the target root record
control_record.retirement: pop on normal/exceptional exit; target catch remains active until cleanup finishes
control_record.lookup: EQ tag, nearest live catch, checked decreasing control chain

dynamic_bindings.binding_index: positive tagged fixnum; zero reserved; distinct from raw tcr_index
dynamic_bindings.vector: owner-assigned capacity; checked current TCR pointer and capacity; no automatic growth
dynamic_bindings.roots: current vector slots are TCR roots; each record roots its symbol and previous value separately
dynamic_bindings.lookup: live TLS value unless no-thread-local-binding, then symbol global value; unbound marker is a checked refusal
dynamic_bindings.restoration: reverse order on every normal or exceptional exit; restore saved TLS marker, not a sampled global value
dynamic_bindings.scope: LET/LET*, required/optional/rest/key/supplied-p SPECIAL bindings, inline and local functions, LOCALLY, references, SETQ and PROGV

progv.validation: Validate finite proper bindable-symbol list and full record budget before values; revalidate after values before binding. Owner-assigned index required.
progv.native_limit: U1 CHECK-SYMBOL-LIST has a native stack-derived length limit; this target uses explicit stack extent instead. Native comparisons through 128 bindings.
progv.refusals: 12 binding eligibility/cycle; 11 invalid owner metadata; 5 malformed list; 2 explicit stack capacity
